tools.name: data_ask_copilot
tools.title: Ask the data hub copilot in free form
tools.description: Ask the data hub copilot in free form; returns its reply and proposed actions. Applies nothing.

message.description: The question for the data hub copilot.

scenario_id.description: The scenario (id or name) the question is about; give this or composition_id.

composition_id.description: The composition (id or name); give this or scenario_id.

profile.description: The load profile to discuss; default: the chosen one.

format.description: Read-only choice of the answer: "text" (default) is the view; "data" is the same facts as one JSON block, for a client that parses them.

tools.name: data_delete
tools.title: Delete a dataset
tools.description: Delete datasets (ids). force=true also deletes ones still in use.

force.description: Also delete it when scenarios or compositions still use it.

format.description: Read-only choice of the answer: "text" (default) is the view; "data" is the same facts as one JSON block, for a client that parses them.

tools.name: data_generate_dataset
tools.title: Generate and save a dataset with AI for a flow
tools.description: Generate and save a dataset with AI for a flow, a scenario or one data slot.

flow_id.description: Generate for a flow: the data its steps need (give this or scenario_id).

scenario_id.description: Generate for a scenario, or (with slot) for one of its data slots.

slot.description: One data slot of the scenario (with scenario_id).

name.description: The name of the new dataset; default: made from the target.

feeder_type.description: The file format of the dataset (not for a slot).

enrich_with_llm.description: A slot only: let a model enrich the values (a cost).

format.description: Read-only choice of the answer: "text" (default) is the view; "data" is the same facts as one JSON block, for a client that parses them.

tools.name: data_get_copilot_history
tools.title: Get the project's data hub conversation
tools.description: Get the project's data hub conversation.

limit.description: How many of the latest messages to return (1-100).

format.description: Read-only choice of the answer: "text" (default) is the view; "data" is the same facts as one JSON block, for a client that parses them.

tools.name: data_get_dataset
tools.title: Get a dataset
tools.description: Get a dataset: columns, recipe, row count; include adds rows (secrets masked), consumers, history, feed snippet, Redis status.

dataset_id.description: The dataset; default: the only one in this workspace.

include.description: rows: a masked preview (secret columns hidden); consumers: who uses it; history: revisions; snippet: the feed snippet; redis: pool status.

rows.description: With include rows: how many rows (1-50).

offset.description: With include rows: the first row.

format.description: Read-only choice of the answer: "text" (default) is the view; "data" is the same facts as one JSON block, for a client that parses them.

tools.name: data_get_generators
tools.title: Get the column generators for dataset rules
tools.description: Get the column generators for dataset rules, or guesses for given column names.

columns.description: Column names to guess generators for, comma-separated (at most 50); without it, the list of all generators.

format.description: Read-only choice of the answer: "text" (default) is the view; "data" is the same facts as one JSON block, for a client that parses them.

tools.name: data_get_slots
tools.title: Get the data slots of a scenario or composition with compat…
tools.description: Get the data slots of a scenario or composition with compatible datasets and current bindings.

scenario_id.description: The scenario; default: the only one in this workspace.

format.description: Read-only choice of the answer: "text" (default) is the view; "data" is the same facts as one JSON block, for a client that parses them.

tools.name: data_list_datasets
tools.title: List the project's datasets
tools.description: List the project's datasets: name, type, columns, row count (no rows).

format.description: Read-only choice of the answer: "text" (default) is the view; "data" is the same facts as one JSON block, for a client that parses them.

tools.name: data_regenerate_dataset
tools.title: Regenerate a dataset's rows from its recipe
tools.description: Regenerate a dataset's rows from its recipe: mode=expand adds rows, mode=reroll replaces all.

dataset_id.description: The dataset; default: the only one in this workspace.

mode.description: expand: add new rows up to `rows`, existing rows stay; reroll: replace all rows with fresh ones.

rows.description: expand: the target row count (required, above the current count); reroll: the new row count (default: the current count).

format.description: Read-only choice of the answer: "text" (default) is the view; "data" is the same facts as one JSON block, for a client that parses them.

tools.name: data_restore_dataset
tools.title: Restore a dataset's previous content
tools.description: Restore a dataset's previous content (a second call switches back).

dataset_id.description: The dataset; default: the only one in this workspace.

format.description: Read-only choice of the answer: "text" (default) is the view; "data" is the same facts as one JSON block, for a client that parses them.

tools.name: data_set_slot_label
tools.title: Set the display label of a scenario's data slot
tools.description: Set the display label of a scenario's data slot.

scenario_id.description: The scenario; default: the only one in this workspace.

format.description: Read-only choice of the answer: "text" (default) is the view; "data" is the same facts as one JSON block, for a client that parses them.

tools.name: data_update_dataset
tools.title: Update a dataset's definition or replace its rows from a file
tools.description: Update a dataset's definition or replace its rows from a file. Direct edit, only on the user's request; normally use data_ask_copilot.

dataset_id.description: The dataset; default: the only one in this workspace.

description.description: The new description; an empty text clears it.

file.description: A CSV file of the project directory (relative path, up to 2 MB) whose rows replace the dataset's; the server reads it.

format.description: Read-only choice of the answer: "text" (default) is the view; "data" is the same facts as one JSON block, for a client that parses them.
